verdict.rationale: Intuit's official QuickBooks Online MCP server README says it exposes 11 financial reports, explicitly including Balance Sheet, P&L and Cash Flow, through the QBO API. That shows the product generates all three core statements. Intuit Intelligence is also documented as generating reports on request, which supports the on-demand part of the story. missing for 10: first-party product docs describing the three statements directly, evidence of custom or any-period date ranges, evidence about accuracy, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
